rule: Use GitHub as the default and primary surface for TRUMP development, review, lineage, artifacts, commits, branches, comparisons, checks and continuity work.
github_default_operations: pull-request and CI inspection when relevant

remote_desktop_commander_policy.allowed_only_when: A materially necessary computation, local-only artifact, or heavy execution cannot reasonably be completed through GitHub/GitHub Actions or repository inspection alone.
examples: heavy exact replay unavailable in CI
required access to a local-only file not present in GitHub

performance_rule: Prefer short targeted GitHub operations over broad local scans or long-running desktop processes.
continuity_rule: Future TRUMP sessions should consult this policy together with registry/TRUMP_CURRENT_STATE.json and docs/TRUMP_DEVELOPMENT_JOURNAL.md before choosing an execution surface.
